label: late original-phase steps (t>=5), favoring inputs p/o/j/f
explanation: Fires almost only in the last few original-token steps of long sequences: orig_idx>=5 holds 94% of activation mass (rate rises from 2.6% at orig_idx 5 to 15% at 8; L=9 gives 53% of mass), plus weak firing at the <DEL> step (4% of mass). It never fires at t<=2 or anywhere in the copy phase. Within that window, firing depends on the current input (p, o, j, f have ~4x lift, then c, z, a) and on earlier tokens (first token d/h/v/w/y/m raise the rate), which looks like a graded mix rather than a crisp rule. Position alone gets 7% precision; adding the p/o/j/f input condition gets dev F1 0.33 (precision 0.26, mass recall 0.54); also requiring >=2 earlier d/h/v/w/y/m tokens reaches only F1 0.35. Top activations are p/o/f/j inputs at t=6-8.
